units.source_text: 左大臣谈及种种往事、桐壶院之事，以及桐壶院对源氏公子的关怀，衣袖始终离不开泪眼，源氏公子亦不免陪着挥泪。

en.t: The Minister of the Left spoke of many things from the past, of the Kiritsubo Emperor, and of the care the retired emperor had shown Prince Genji; his sleeves never left his tearful eyes, and Prince Genji could not help weeping with him.

units.source_text: 小公子无心无思地走来走去，有时偎傍外祖父，有时亲近父亲。

en.t: The little boy wandered about without a thought, sometimes nestling close to his grandfather, sometimes drawing near to his father.

units.source_text: 左大臣看了异常伤心，又说：“逝世之人，我时刻不忘，至今犹有余悲。

en.t: Seeing this, the Minister of the Left was deeply saddened and said again, "The one who has passed away is never absent from my thoughts, and even now grief still remains.

units.source_text: 但倘此人尚在世间，目睹此种逆事，不知何等伤心。

en.t: Yet if that person were still in this world and saw such a cruel reversal, who can say how heartbroken she would be?

units.source_text: 今短命而死，免得做此噩梦，在我反觉心慰。

en.t: Since she died young and was spared this nightmare, I find, instead, some comfort in it.

units.source_text: 惟此幼小孩童，长此依附老人膝下，不得亲近慈父，实为最可悲伤之事。

en.t: But for this small child to remain dependent on an old man and be unable to live close to his loving father is truly the saddest thing of all.

units.source_text: 古人即使真犯罪过，亦不致身受如此之重罚。

en.t: Even in ancient times, a person who had truly committed a crime would not have suffered such a heavy punishment.

units.source_text: 吾婿蒙此不白之冤，想是前世孽障所致。

en.t: That my son-in-law should bear this unjust accusation must, I suppose, be due to some karmic burden from a former life.

units.source_text: 此种冤狱，在外国朝廷亦不乏其例，然必有明确可指之罪状。

en.t: Cases of wrongful punishment like this are not unknown even in foreign courts, but there is always some definite charge that can be pointed to.

units.source_text: 但此次之事，教人百思不得其原由，实甚可恨！”

en.t: But in this present matter, no matter how one thinks it over, the reason cannot be found; it is truly bitter and hateful!"
His speech went on at great length, and it cannot all be set down here.
